Projects.Name: AWS.AgentCore.Hosting
ChangelogMessages: Added OpenTelemetry instrumentation support. IChatClient and AIAgent are wrapped with .UseOpenTelemetry() decorators that emit traces and metrics under standard Microsoft AI activity sources. Users wire their own OTel pipeline and call AddAgentCoreInstrumentation() on TracerProviderBuilder/MeterProviderBuilder to subscribe AgentCore sources and meters.
